scope: Bounded research prototypes; does not change the 0.7.0 Core API or production dependencies.
transforms: Two random crops per band with independent width/height and integer offsets; first lossless PNG, second scaled to longest edge 384 and JPEG75 decoded to PNG. No snap to product windows.
labels: Compare each crop query only with original gallery files; same source is positive. All variants from a source stay in the same development or held-out source partition. Different file IDs are negative, without human semantic adjudication.

grid154.evidence: candidate only; fixed grid and minimum eligible Hamming witness, not arbitrary crop completeness

orb400.evidence: candidate only; mutual binary descriptor matches with ratio filter, bounded RANSAC partial affine geometry, >=50% inliers, >=15% query span per axis and mapped corners within 10% of gallery bounds

orb800.evidence: same geometric evidence contract as orb400, larger feature cap

selectionRule: Among development-pass profiles choose highest original-crop recall; ties choose lower descriptor/hash work then lower measured wall time. Failed profiles stop without more parameter trials. Freeze selected implementation and parameters before acquiring new-source image content.
limitations: These thresholds are exploration gates, not real-world accuracy guarantees.
No learned provider/API calls. No production MoonBit integration implied by a Python/OpenCV research pass.
No approximate global-image prefilter; every gallery/query pair is tested unless the explicit time cap produces an incomplete rejected run.
Source-file negatives, controlled crops, and one local timing run cannot establish natural-contamination accuracy or large-scale performance.
